A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MSTA study. All 12 pages, including figures, tables, equations, limitations, pseudocode and references, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MSTA video-recognition experiments in Tables 2–5, ablations in Tables 6–7 and computational measurements in Table 8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, ablation and computational results reported in Tables 2–8.

M1.justification: The shared multimodal adapter, spatial and temporal projections, consistency constraint and training objective are identical in Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2.

E1.justification: Both versions report the same coverage of Kinetics-400/600, HMDB-51, UCF-101 and Something-Something V2 across zero-shot, few-shot, base-to-novel and fully supervised evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within each experiment in Tables 2–5, including the retained comparisons with ViCLIP, AdaptFormer and LoRA.

E3.justification: Table 1 and Sections 4.1–4.2 retain identical splits, backbone, training budgets, preprocessing, frame/view protocols and metrics. The few-shot sample counts are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.4 and Tables 6–8 retain the same component, dimension, scaling, loss-weight, description-count, insertion-layer and description-type analyses, plus computational cost measurements.

E5.justification: Kinetics-600 averaging over three splits and the uncertainty reporting in Table 4 are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises run-count, seed or statistical estimation information.

E6.justification: Figure 1, Tables 2–8 and the results prose are identical. For example, Table 4 reports the same MSTA plus consistency-constraint Kinetics-600 result of 74.5 ± 0.5 in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(16) and their mathematical definitions and explanations are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain identical claims about MSTA, description-guided consistency, parameter efficiency and generalization.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including concerns about coupled visual/text gradients and performance degradation from low-quality LLM descriptions in Section 6.

D1.justification: Table 1, Section 4.2 and Algorithms 1–2 retain identical hyperparameters, hardware and implementation details. The promised code availability and repository link target are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning throughout the paper and all 44 references are identical.

P1.justification: v2 changes Zizheng Huang's affiliation marker from 3 to 2 and Yanshuo Wang's from 2 to 3, removes a duplicate author-list comma and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3, Tables 1–8, algorithm displays, captions and page organization are unchanged. Pages 2–12 render identically; first-page differences are confined to author and version text.

improvement.justification: The revision only changes affiliation markers, removes a duplicate comma and updates the version/date stamp. Scientific content, evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain identical, so these front-matter edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
